title: SQL Injection in User Login Handler
expected_vulnerabilities: Unsanitized user input formatted directly into SQL query string
expected_remediations: Parameterized query / Prepared statements (e.g. cursor.execute('SELECT ... WHERE username = %s', (user_id,)))

title: OS Command Injection in Ping Service
expected_vulnerabilities: Use of shell=True with unvalidated/unescaped string formatting
expected_remediations: Pass arguments as a list with shell=False (e.g. subprocess.check_output(['ping', '-c', '4', host_ip], shell=False))
Validate IP / hostname format with regex or ipaddress library

title: Path Traversal in File Download Endpoint
expected_vulnerabilities: User could supply '../../etc/passwd' to break out of '/var/www/uploads'
expected_remediations: Use os.path.realpath / Path.resolve() and verify path starts with base directory
Sanitize filename using werkzeug.utils.secure_filename or whitelist
